assessments.reasoning: The exact-byte public preview has issuer and edition metadata consistent with ISO’s own catalog. Clause 1 directly describes the Framework’s contribution and the usage of its concepts, terms and notation in the other series parts.

challenge.method: I extracted and read PDF page 15 of the exact preview and compared it with ISO’s catalog Scope. I checked the cover, document hierarchy and the separate corrigendum listing. https://www.iso.org/standard/76583.html https://www.iso.org/standard/93690.html
challenge.results: Clause 1 assigns the shared conceptual framework, terms and notation to this document and describes how other parts use them. The publisher’s Scope has the same division. Statement-level grammar or processing requirements would require the relevant clauses in the other parts.

limitations: The descriptive finding is limited to the title and scope of the June 2023 public preview.
ISO lists a separate 2026 corrigendum. Detailed convention wording and application to particular statements are outside this review.
